title: Brown has met someone who saw a UFO in a hangar

tellings.quote: Have you met anybody who you think has seen a UFO in a in a hangar? Like >> Oh, in a hanger. >> Yeah. >> Yes.

plain: Matthew Brown, introduced on the show as a Pentagon whistleblower, says he has met somebody he thinks has seen a UFO kept in a hangar. Michels asks him directly, and Brown answers simply, "Yes." If true, someone he knows has seen a craft in human hands.
